name: Booking.com Scraper
description: Booking scraper for Python and the command line: Booking.com hotels and apartments around a city or street address for your dates, with stay price, price per night, discount, review score, stars, distance and free-cancellation flag, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: search
commands.help: Booking.com properties around a place or address for your dates
commands.description: Booking.com properties around a place or address for your dates — price, discount, distance, badges, review score.

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: City, area or street address, e.g. "Roma, Italia" or "12 Marine Parade, Napier, New Zealand". Resolved to coordinates first; pass latitude/longitude instead to skip that step.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Interface language, e.g. en, it, de.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many properties to deliver at most (1–100). You pay only for delivered properties.
